content.text: Selling digital products such as ebooks, templates, and courses is increasingly constrained by platforms like PayPal and Gumroad, especially in regions like Nigeria and Ghana. These platforms impose high fees and limit access, forcing creators to seek [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/alternatives-gumroad-payhip-restricted-countries-what-nobody-tells-6|Alternatives to]]. Now, you can take control of your commerce infrastructure without relying on these services. By leveraging [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-2|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments through NOWPayments and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-step-step-13|deploying]] your own stack, you can retain more of your earnings and establish sovereignty over your digital sales.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms like Gumroad charge up to 10% per sale, which can significantly cut into your profits. For instance, selling 100 units of a $97 product through Gumroad would result in $921 lost to fees compared to just $49 with NOWPayments. This infrastructure not only reduces transaction costs but also eliminates the dependency on platforms that may restrict access due to local banking issues or regulatory hurdles. By utilizing free hosting and backend solutions, you create a resilient digital store that operates independently.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, gather the digital products you plan to sell, such as ebooks or courses. You will also need a domain name and access to either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and decide on a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for managing orders. Lastly, ensure you set up a NOWPayments account for seamless crypto payment processing, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring you can cater to various customer preferences.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your chosen stack, either the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Configure NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions directly on your store. Integrate the payment solution with your backend to automatically verify transactions and trigger product delivery. You can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage this process effectively. File delivery can be streamlined using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation.
Reduce your transaction fees to just 0.5% with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is deployed and your payment pipeline is configured, perform a live test transaction. Ensure that the payment process works smoothly and that the delivery mechanism activates correctly. Monitor your dashboard for real-time analytics to track sales and customer interactions. It’s crucial to iron out any issues before promoting your store widely. Once confirmed working, you can start marketing your digital products through social media and other channels to generate interest and drive traffic.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, consider scaling your operations. You can add more products to your store or expand your offerings, including courses, presets, or software. Use the insights gained from your analytics to identify trends and adjust your inventory accordingly. With the Complete Builder Kit, you gain access to additional blueprints and templates that can help streamline further deployments and enhancements to your store. This ensures you remain agile and responsive to market demands.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Own your digital store and eliminate platform dependency.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell ebooks by deploying your own stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, which avoids the restrictions of traditional payment platforms.

Using NOWPayments allows you to process crypto transactions at a mere 0.5% fee, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad. This method empowers you to retain more revenue from your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by establishing your own store using free hosting and backend solutions, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers without relying on services like Gumroad or Payhip.
How can I ensure instant delivery of my digital products?
Implement automated delivery through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which can trigger file delivery immediately upon successful payment confirmation. This enhances customer satisfaction.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a wide range of customer preferences and ensuring flexible payment options for your digital products.
